entities.name: PMID:27497684
observations: Post-hoc observational study of Chinese participants reported serum copeptin 9.4 vs 4.1 pmol/L in T2DM versus controls; adjusted T2DM OR 1.312 (95% CI 1.204–1.403).

Among 306 T2DM patients, copeptin was positively associated with retinopathy (adjusted OR 1.117) and nephropathy (adjusted OR 1.259); highest-versus-lowest quartile ORs were 2.83 and 3.48, respectively.
Evidence is observational and does not establish causality; the report did not establish cardiovascular complications.

entities.name: Copeptin
observations: Serum copeptin was associated with T2DM, diabetic retinopathy, and diabetic nephropathy in one Chinese post-hoc observational study (PMID:27497684).

entities.name: Type 2 diabetes mellitus
observations: In one Chinese observational study, serum copeptin was higher in T2DM than controls and showed an adjusted positive association (PMID:27497684).
